Hills, Goats, Ocean.
A photo from a walk on 15 June, 2024.
📷 OM-D E-M5 & 45 mm ƒ1.8, shot at ƒ8.

photos.alt: A vertical photo of a landscape. On the bottom of the frame, there is one goat (brown with white) standing on the grass surrounded by yellow flowers. Further downhill there is another goat (mostly white). Both of them are looking into the camera. Further, there are some bushes, then trees, then some power lines and a road going uphill, and swirling from left to right around a big hill. On that hill there are more power lines, some structures, cliffs, and trees. Behind that hill, on the left, a bit of an ocean is visible, with the top of the frame taken by the clear blue sky.
